data.name: Courtly Presence
data.description: A battle scion's bearing radiates command and presence, allowing her to tower over her opponents in social situations. The battle scion adds %1 to Intimidate checks, and she starts any verbal duel (see page 176) with an extra edge that she can use for the presence tactic so long as she is not at a significant or extreme disadvantage in the duel. However, her bardic knowledge ability applies to only Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (history), Knowledge (local), and Knowledge (nobility).|CourtlyPresenceSkillBonus
